terminals.name: runtime
terminals.description: Oxbit Node runtime for the /workspace project (files, terminals, tasks, Git, language services). Pair the web UI to http://127.0.0.1:9277 using the printed owner pairing code.
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1; export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH"; export OXBIT_WORKSPACE=/workspace OXBIT_ORIGINS=http://localhost:9279,http://127.0.0.1:9279 OXBIT_WATCH_POLLING=1; bun run dev

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Oxbit React web UI with hot reload. Open http://localhost:9279 and pair with the runtime terminal's pairing code.
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1; export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version default)/bin:$PATH"; bun run dev:web
